mapper.insert:
INSERT INTO ai_cost_records (model, intent, call_count, input_tokens, output_tokens, total_tokens, estimated_cost, window_start, window_end) VALUES
(#{r.model}, #{r.intent}, #{r.callCount}, #{r.inputTokens}, #{r.outputTokens}, #{r.totalTokens}, #{r.estimatedCost}, #{r.windowStart}, #{r.windowEnd})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE call_count = call_count + VALUES(call_count), input_tokens = input_tokens + VALUES(input_tokens), output_tokens = output_tokens + VALUES(output_tokens), total_tokens = total_tokens + VALUES(total_tokens), estimated_cost = estimated_cost + VALUES(estimated_cost)
mapper.select: SELECT model, SUM(call_count) AS callCount, SUM(input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS outputTokens, SUM(total_tokens) AS totalTokens, SUM(estimated_cost) AS estimatedCost FROM ai_cost_records GROUP BY model ORDER BY estimatedCost DESC

SELECT intent, SUM(call_count) AS callCount, SUM(input_tokens) AS inputTokens, SUM(output_tokens) AS outputTokens, SUM(total_tokens) AS totalTokens, SUM(estimated_cost) AS estimatedCost FROM ai_cost_records GROUP BY intent ORDER BY estimatedCost DESC
